channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 20 November
item.description: The blockchain network fixed several issues, added a downgrade feature, and updated documentation; the SDK tools received a security hardening update and the cognitive system added a test change. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusSDK, openapi-client-scaffold, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 19 November
item.description: The blockchain network added new research phases, upgraded components, and added tests, while the website documentation was clarified and document hashes were synchronized. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, gitbook, documentation, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, openapi-client-scaffold, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 18 November
item.description: The blockchain network revised plans based on feedback and added new test work; the SDK tools fixed pagination, added user‑list overrides and role seeds, and documentation was updated. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: The blockchain network created new phase plans and added durability checks; the SDK tools added user‑list overrides and role seeds, and a template tool was updated for third‑party resolution. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: The blockchain network applied a merge fix and added test work related to marker handling. Repositories: SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: The wallet added temporary diagnostic prints to aid verification. Repositories: GeniusWallet.
